# WorkplaceHQ

> WorkplaceHQ helps organizations across Africa build AI-ready, high-performing teams through structured training programs, hands-on workshops, and advisory consulting. It also operates Lagos Jobs, a careers platform connecting job seekers with verified local job listings, migration advisory, and study-abroad support.

WorkplaceHQ works with businesses on: diagnosing performance gaps, running practical training and workshops (AI/automation, sales, communication, performance management), and leadership/organizational consulting. Lagos Jobs is a separate but related product under the same company, focused on job seekers in Lagos, Nigeria.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://workplacehq.com/): overview of WorkplaceHQ's training, workshops, and consulting services.
- [About](https://workplacehq.com/about): company approach, principles, and team.
- [Services](https://workplacehq.com/services): detailed breakdown of training, workshop, and consulting offerings.
- [Resources](https://workplacehq.com/resources): free whitepapers, toolkits, frameworks, and reports.
- [Insights](https://workplacehq.com/insights): articles on team performance, training, and workplace trends.
- [FAQ](https://workplacehq.com/faq): answers to common questions about services, resources, and data privacy.
- [Contact](https://workplacehq.com/contact): consultation requests and general inquiries.

## Lagos Jobs (careers product)

- [Lagos Jobs Home](https://workplacehq.com/lagos-jobs): overview of the careers platform.
- [Job Listings](https://workplacehq.com/lagos-jobs/listings): current verified job openings in Lagos.
- [Career Tools](https://workplacehq.com/lagos-jobs/services): CV review, ATS scoring, and career support tools.
- [About Lagos Jobs](https://workplacehq.com/lagos-jobs/about): product values and mission.
- [Contact Lagos Jobs](https://workplacehq.com/lagos-jobs/contact): hiring partner and job seeker inquiries.

## Notes for AI agents and crawlers

- This is a JavaScript single-page application; pages render client-side. Meta tags, titles, and structured data are injected per-route via React Helmet.
- A full URL list is available at [sitemap.xml](https://workplacehq.com/sitemap.xml).
- Contact for business inquiries: info@workplacehq.com (WorkplaceHQ) / lagosjobsinfo@gmail.com (Lagos Jobs).
